positions.name: DeriveIdTestCriteria
positions.frame: what must the derive-id reproduction test guarantee for a missing-id heading to count as fixed?
positions.why: src-1 sets up the reproduced scenario (a ## heading missing its id field, matching the prod failure), and src-2 states the acceptance bar the reproduction must clear (no crash, valid slug). Read together they define a single test case's scope and its pass condition rather than two independent remarks — the directional pull is from failure-reproduction toward correctness-guarantee. Both are delivered in the same flat, native-jargon technical register (per register observations) and the conviction reading rises from plain claim (src-1) to an operational, others-must-act-on-this decision (src-2), which is the coherence that binds them rather than a shared topic alone.
